---
title: "get_indices"
format: html
editor: source
---
1. Load in biomass predictions and create density column.
2. Change biomass predictions to crs 3338 (same as arrowtooth condition model)
3. Join biomass predictions to surveyjoin+ grid.
4. Make predictions on arrowtooth condition model, using the grid supplied.
5. Use get_weighted_average() on the predictions from #4. 
6. Visualize indices.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(surveyjoin)
library(sdmTMB)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
get_wa <- function(species = c("arrowtooth", "perch", "shortspine", "dover", "dogfish"), sex = c("F", "M"), region = c("nwfsc", "pbs", "afsc")) {
  species <- match.arg(species)
  region <- match.arg(region)
  
  # Get body condition model
  path <- paste0("models/", species, ".rds") 
  model <- readRDS(path)$base_centered

  # Get biomass predictions --> load into new env and grab object
  #file <- list.files("biomass_predictions", pattern = species, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  files <- list.files("biomass_predictions")
  file <- files[grepl(region, files) & grepl(species, files)]
  
  if (region == "nwfsc" & species != "shortspine") {
    e <- new.env()
    load(file, envir = e)
    obj_name <- ls(e)[1]
    biomass_predictions <- get(obj_name, envir = e)
  } else {
    biomass_predictions <- readRDS(paste0("biomass_predictions/", file))
  }

  # Add density and format the biomass predictions
  message("Adding density column to biomass predictions and setting coords...")
  
  if (region == "nwfsc") {
    biomass_predictions <- biomass_predictions |>
      mutate(density = plogis(est1) * exp(est2)) |>
      mutate(X = X*1000, Y = Y*1000) |> # converting km to m because crs32610 expects meters
      st_as_sf(coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = 32610) |>
      st_transform(3338) |>
      mutate(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[,1],
             y = st_coordinates(geometry)[,2]) |>
      select(x,y,density, year)
  }
  
  if (region == "pbs") {
    biomass_predictions <- biomass_predictions |>
      st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
      st_transform(3338) |>
      mutate(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[,1],
             y = st_coordinates(geometry)[,2]) |>
      rename(density = biomass_density)
  }
  
  # Get grid from surveyjoin removing species-specific data-sparse areas
  message("Getting grid and attempting spatial join...")
  grid <- switch(region,
                 "nwfsc" = surveyjoin::nwfsc_grid,
                 "pbs" = surveyjoin::dfo_synoptic_grid,
                 "afsc" = surveyjoin::afsc_grid)
  grid <- grid |>
    filter(!survey %in% c("Northern Bering Sea Crab/Groundfish Survey - Eastern Bering Sea Shelf Survey Extension", "Eastern Bering Sea Slope Bottom Trawl Survey", "Triennial"))
  if (unique(model$data$common_name) == "pacific spiny dogfish") {
    grid <- grid |> filter(!grepl("Bering", survey), !grepl("Aleutian",survey), !grepl("Gulf",survey), survey!="SYN WCHG")}
  if (unique(model$data$common_name) == "dover sole") {
    grid <- grid |> filter(!grepl("Aleutian", survey))}
  if (unique(model$data$common_name) %in% c("dover sole","shortspine thornyhead","pacific ocean perch", "pacific spiny dogfish")) {
    grid <- grid |> filter(!grepl("Eastern Bering Sea Crab", survey))}
  if (unique(model$data$common_name) %in% c("pacific ocean perch")) {
    grid <- grid |> filter(lat >= 40)}
  if (unique(model$data$common_name) == "arrowtooth flounder") {
    grid <- grid |> filter(lat >= 34)
  }
  
  # Add time, length, sex. Has to be after the filters!!
  grid <- expand_grid(grid, year = unique(model$data$year)) |>
    mutate(length_cm = mean(model$data$length_cm, na.rm = T)) |>
    mutate(log_lengthc = mean(model$data$log_lengthc, na.rm=T)) |>
    mutate(region = case_when(
      survey == "NWFSC.Combo" ~ "nwfsc",
      survey %in% c("SYN QCS", "SYN HS", "SYN WCVI", "SYN WCHG") ~ "pbs",
      .default = "afsc"))
  if (sex == "F") {
    grid <- grid |> mutate(sex = "F")
  } else if (sex == "M") {grid <- grid |> mutate(sex = "M")}
  
  # Turn grid into spatial object for joining
  grid_sf <- grid |>
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) |>
    st_transform(3338)
  
  # Do spatial join to biomass_predictions by year, setting coordinates
  joined_grid_list <- list()
  for (yr in unique(grid$year)) {
    grid_year <- grid_sf |> filter(year == yr)
    biomass_year <- biomass_predictions |> filter(year == yr) |>select(-year)
    if (nrow(grid_year)>0 && nrow(biomass_predictions) >0) {
      joined_year <- grid_year |>
        st_join(biomass_year, join = st_nearest_feature, maxdist = 500)
      joined_grid_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- joined_year}}
  joined_grid <- bind_rows(joined_grid_list)
  final_grid <- joined_grid |>
    mutate(X = st_coordinates(geometry)[,1] / 1000, # divide to convert m to km because condition model expects km
           Y = st_coordinates(geometry)[,2] / 1000) |>
    as.data.frame()

  # Predict on grid
  message("Predicting body condition on the new data and getting weighted average...")
  pred <- predict(model, final_grid, return_tmb_object = TRUE)
  pred$data <- pred$data |>
    mutate(species = unique(model$data$common_name)) 
  
  # Get weighted average using predictions and density vector
  wa <- get_weighted_average(pred, vector = pred$data$density)
  wa$species <- species
  wa$region <- region
  
  rm(e)
  invisible(gc())
  return(wa)
}


a <- get_wa("arrowtooth", "F") 
b <- get_wa("dover", "F")
c <- get_wa("perch", "F")
d <- get_wa("dogfish", "F")
e <- get_wa("shortspine", "F")

f <- get_wa("arrowtooth", "F", "pbs")
g <- get_wa("dover", "F", "pbs")
h <- get_wa("perch", "F", "pbs")
i <- get_wa("dogfish", "F", "pbs")
j <- get_wa("shortspine", "F", "pbs")

k <- bind_rows(f,g,h,i,j, indices)
saveRDS(k, "indices.rds")
# Ideas for visuals
ggplot(data = k, aes(x = year, y = est, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~region) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha=0.3) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data = f, aes(x = year, y = est, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), width = 0.3) +
  theme_minimal()


```
